# Hike Simien Mountains

> Ethiopia trekking tours led by Ginbie Abebe, a licensed local guide based in Gondar. Fully custom itineraries, fully equipped expeditions. No packages — every trip is built around the traveler.

## About

Ginbie Abebe is a licensed mountain guide born and raised in Debark, at the gateway to the Simien Mountains. He studied Geography at Gondar University and has 5+ years of guiding experience. He is first-aid trained, an expert in local wildlife, and a competitive half-marathon runner. Rated 4.9 on TripAdvisor.

## Destinations

- [Simien Mountains Trekking](https://www.hikesimiens.com/#treks): Flagship destination. UNESCO World Heritage site. 1–10 day treks. Home to Gelada baboons, Walia ibex, and the Ethiopian wolf.
- [Danakil Depression & Erta Ale](https://www.hikesimiens.com/#destinations): One of the hottest places on Earth. Sulphur springs, salt flats, active lava lake. 3–4 days.
- [Lalibela & Historic Circuit](https://www.hikesimiens.com/#destinations): Rock-hewn churches, ancient empires, Gondar castles, Axum. 2–5 days.
- [Omo Valley Cultural Tours](https://www.hikesimiens.com/#destinations): Remote tribes and living traditions in southern Ethiopia. 4–7 days.
- [Tigray Churches Tour](https://www.hikesimiens.com/#destinations): Ancient cliff-face and cave churches. 3–5 days.
- [Bale Mountains Hiking](https://www.hikesimiens.com/#destinations): Ethiopian wolf country, Afroalpine wilderness. 4–7 days.
- [Wildlife & Birdwatch Tours](https://www.hikesimiens.com/#destinations): 800+ bird species, endemic mammals and plants. 2–5 days.

## Trek Options (Simien Mountains)

- 1–3 days: Sankabar escarpment (3,250m), Gelada baboons, Jinibar waterfalls
- 4–6 days (most popular): Gich camp, Imet Gogo viewpoint, Chenek (3,620m), Walia ibex, Ethiopian wolf sightings, optional Ras Dashen summit
- 7–10 days: Full expedition to Ras Dashen (4,550m, Ethiopia's highest peak), remote wilderness camps, deep wolf habitat

## What's Included

Licensed guide, park scout, cook and all meals, tents and sleeping gear, mules and porters, transport from Gondar.
